page.overview:
Who is Count of Ventimiglia?

The Count of Ventimiglia, also known as the "Black Corsair," was a notorious gentlemen-pirate in the second millennium IC.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ventimiglia Counts of Ventimiglia] existed in the real world and were the rulers of the Ligurian city of Ventimiglia in the north of Italy.
